sentences.en: The river descends from the mountains to the bay below.
sentences.zh: 河水从山间流下来，最终汇入下方的海湾。

sentences.en: All humans on Earth are descended from a common ancestor.
sentences.zh: 地球上的所有人类都源自同一个祖先。

sentences.en: Humans are not descended from apes, except for some people.
sentences.zh: 人类并非来自猿类，除非是某些人的说法。

senses.zh: 下降；下来；遗传；屈尊；下去 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（向下）+scend（爬）→向下爬→下降
